summary: Old Second Bancorp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 announcing that its Board declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.08 per share. The dividend is payable November 9, 2026, to stockholders of record as of October 30, 2026, with the filing signed by COO/CFO Bradley S. Adams. No advisor, premium, or structural terms are present. This is a routine capital-return declaration rather than a special situation; the watch angle is only the modest payout's sustainability relative to earnings and any future dividend growth signals.
